 =============================
 Dated this the 4th day of June, 2024
 Judgment
In Wp(C) No. 8298/2024, the writ petitioner challenges the provisional order directing the
demolition of a building. Wp(C) No. 1910/2024 was filed to direct the Panchayat to take appropriate
action ag ainst the illegal construction allegedly made by the petitioner in the connected case . 
2. This Court passed an order on 1.4.2024 directing the second respondent to take a final decision after hearing the petitioners in both cases. 
3. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioners that orders have been passed as directed by this Court and the petitioner in WP(C) No. 8298/2024 has challenged the same before the Tribunal. This is recorded. 
Nothing further remains to be adjudicated in these writ petitions. 
Accordingly, the Writ Petitions are closed. 
Sd/-
